pr.title: Move every service module to the structured logger
pr.body: Moves every module, the tests and the service docs from `src/lib/legacyLog.js` to the new pino-based `src/lib/logger.js`. Some calls switch to pino's `(obj, msg)` order. Also tidies the attachment download route while touching its logging.

files.patch:
@@ -2,6 +2,6 @@
 
 The billing service has four modules: `store`, `workflow`, `reports`, `notifications`.
 
-Each module logs through `src/lib/legacyLog.js`.
+Each module logs through `src/lib/logger.js` with a `module` field.
 
 Every state change sets `lastAction` and `updatedAt`, and returns null when the id does not exist.
